_note: A dispatch-scheduler plan entry for the FLWO 60-inch (robofast_core/dispatch.py; docs/design.md 3.7):
Placeholders: the altitude limit follows tcsgo.json (min_alt 20); instruments names the TRES CCD 'tres'.
calstage: the TRES front end's named positions (tres_frontend.json); lamps: the lamp outlets of the
Pulizzi switch (pulizzi.json). Listing lamps is what allows ARC and LAMP_FLAT requests on this
telescope (docs/pulizzi.md); MINERVA lists none, so they are refused there.
state is relative to this file here; use an absolute path in production.
